name: filterable-table-header
description: Rendered-node template for any filterable financial table header cell.
appliesTo: Any financial table list field included in that list's filterableColumns.
validation: Field must be present in the current list's filterableColumns.
sortFilterIcon must exist as a rendered child node, not only as a text note or asset list entry.
Header text stays xzl/color/text/tertiary in active state.
Only the active arrow direction changes to xzl/color/primary/red.
Header cell must share the same fixed column box and right edge as body values.
